facts.business: Gokul Refoils & Solvent Limited is engaged in the manufacturing, refining, processing, and marketing of a diversified portfolio of edible oils (groundnut, mustard, cottonseed, soybean, palm, sunflower) and non-edible oils (castor oil) along with organic fertilizers and by-products, catering to domestic and international markets.

key_risks: Lower nutrient concentration of organic fertilizers compared to chemical fertilizers increasing transportation, storage, and application costs
Varying quality and nutrient composition of organic inputs
Dependence on availability of raw materials for organic fertilizers
Limited awareness among farming communities regarding long-term benefits of organic soil management
Revenue recognition pressures due to listed entity status and stakeholder expectations
